nodeTypes.description: PM-assisted synchronous reluctance machine (PMa-SyRM, the Energica bike class): the complete hybrid form of the PMSM dq Euler - PM flux Lambda with strong saliency (Ld != Lq, the reluctance product (Ld-Lq)*Id*Iq is often the dominant share of torque). Physics is byte-equivalent to Plant.Machine.PmsmDq; the separate template keeps library users from mistaking the family for a non-salient PMSM. Defaults pack: PMa-SyRM tendencies (Lambda small, saliency ratio Lq/Ld > 1 in bike class or Ld/Lq > 1 reluctance-dominant - instance params decide).

inputPorts.description: Electrical rotor speed, rad/s, from Plant.Shaft.* nodes.
inputPorts.name: Omega_Elec

inputPorts.description: >=0.5 routes the machine into the six-switch-open freewheel collapse (gate-reset / power-cut / PWM gate-off); <0.5 = live. Defaults to 0 when unconnected.
inputPorts.name: OpenGates

outputPorts.description: Electrical air-gap power drawn from/into the winding, W (positive = absorbed).
outputPorts.name: P_Elec

Lambda.description: PM flux linkage, Wb (small vs classic IPM - SyRM characteristics are saliency-driven).

Ld.description: d-axis inductance, H (PMa-SyRM saliency: differs strongly from Lq).

When the OpenGates input is driven >= 0.5 (by a Plant.Fault.Point node) the machine enters the six-switch-open freewheel collapse.

nodeTypes.description: Synchronous two-quadrant DC/DC buck/boost cell: average model at the plant timescale (switching ripple below our dt resolution, ignored). The inductor integrates from the duty-windowed effective leg voltage with the inverter-class knee + deadtime + Rce distortion on the winding side; the average draw from the high bus is duty * i_L and handles buck and boost directions by current sign. OpenGates freewheel-collapses with the family 2 ms evidence time constant. Duty is a controller-side external (host-assigned per control period; unwired zero-binds for open-loop scripts via set_input / PlantSetInput / rte sim 'plant-input').

inputPorts.description: High-side switch on-time fraction, percent (0-100). Controller-side external (unwired zero-binds; script per period via set_input).
inputPorts.name: Duty

outputPorts.name: I_L

outputPorts.description: Current into the low side, A (= i_L).
outputPorts.name: I_Low

outputPorts.name: P_High

outputPorts.description: Power into the low side, W (= V_Low * I_Low).
outputPorts.name: P_Low

nodeTypes.description: Surface permanent-magnet synchronous machine: non-salient dq Euler with a single per-phase inductance L_H (Ld == Lq by construction, so no reluctance term can creep in - torque is strictly 1.5*pp*Lambda*iq). This is the template to reach for when the motor is a SPMSM/SMPM; for salient machines use PmsmDq (IPM) or SynRelPmsm (PMa-SyRM). Physics mirrors the SPMSM subtree of twin/plant/plant.py with Ld == Lq.

Three-phase induction machine (5th-order coupled-L) solved in the stationary frame (wf=0) for numerical robustness at line frequency - control-agnostic model that serves both scalar (V/Hz) and vector/FOC drive; slip enters via machine speed; air-gap power returns at the command (synchronous) speed on the Omega_Cmd input. Matches twin/plant/induction.py.

inputPorts.name: Omega_Cmd

nodeTypes.description: Total inverter loss from the phenomenological fitted law L = k1|i| + k2 i^2 + k3|w| + k4|i w| + k5*vdc*|i| (v2 coefficients, calibrated against 7 recorded campaigns 2026-10-20). Splits into plate share for the thermal plant; carries the energy-balance term p_link_drawn the DcBus needs. Domain-guarded at zero (data-law span guard).

inputPorts.description: >= 0.5 disables losses (gates off); 0 = live (zero-bound default when unconnected).
inputPorts.name: Idle

outputPorts.description: Total inverter loss (machine winding + devices + speed/friction + bench residual), W.
outputPorts.name: P_Loss

outputPorts.description: Plate share of the loss heating the baseplate NTC, W.
outputPorts.name: P_Plate

outputPorts.description: Count of domain-guard zero-floor engagements (persistent state; extrapolation guard fired = fitted-data span left).
outputPorts.name: FloorHits

PlateShare.description: Fraction of total loss heating the baseplate (rest: machine winding/friction/bench).

nodeTypes.description: Analog sin/cos encoder emitting integer counts with the recorded healthy bounds and mid-scale offsets; counts rail low on disconnect (encoder-loss artifact). One electrical cycle per mechanical rev.

OffsetDeg.description: Physical zero-alignment offset (electrical degrees) subtracted from ThetaE.

nodeTypes.description: Analytic macroscopic switched reluctance machine: algebraic flux map psi(i, theta) from aligned/unaligned curves with a (1+cos(Nr*theta))/2 tooth profile (Asgar/Ellis form); currents integrate per-phase from the winding voltages with the position-varying incremental inductance and motion back-EMF; torque is the exact analytic coenergy derivative (validated finite-difference to 1e-4 relative). Unipolar per-phase drive family: each phase winding takes one voltage input directly (no dq frame, no pole-pair map). OpenGates freewheel-collapses with the same 2 ms time constant as the other machines. Omega_Elec carries MECHANICAL rad/s here (no synchronous frame exists in an SRM; shaft nodes must use Poles=1 to express mechanical speed). Teeth-phases stagger 2*pi/(phases*Nr); 3-phase default in v1.

inputPorts.description: Phase W winding voltage, V (optional - leave unwired for 2-phase setups).
inputPorts.name: V_W

inputPorts.description: MECHANICAL shaft speed, rad/s (port-name compatibility with the machine family; an SRM has no synchronous frame).
inputPorts.name: Omega_Elec

outputPorts.description: Total electromechanical torque over the phases, N m.
outputPorts.name: Torque

outputPorts.description: Flux linkage of the most-energized phase's aligned curve at its current, Wb (truth tap for the saturation map).
outputPorts.name: PsiAligned

outputPorts.description: Instantaneous electrical winding input power (sum v*i over active phases), W; zero while gates are open.
outputPorts.name: P_Elec

Ka.description: Aligned saturation constant, 1/A (aligned unsaturated slope = LambdaSat*Ka = L_unsat).

LU_H.description: Unaligned inductance, H (lambda_u(i) = L_u * i - the unaligned tooth position is nearly linear).

LambdaSat.description: Aligned saturated flux linkage level, Wb (lambda_a(i) = LambdaSat * (1 - e^{-Ka*i})).

RotorTeeth.description: Rotor pole count (teeth); the tooth period is 2*pi/Nr mechanical.

nodeTypes.description: Dual Active Bridge DC/DC: two full bridges through an HF transformer with the standard square-wave average power law  P = V_HV * (V_LV * Ratio) * phi * (pi - |phi|) / (2 * pi^2 * f_sw * L_k) , phase phi in radians between bridge switching midpoints (controller-side external via set_input; unwired zero-binds). Power flows from the leading bridge; zero at phi=0, clamped at |phi|=pi. Gate kill stops both bridges (no freewheel integrator - the transfer dies with the bridges). No internal dynamic state: I_High/I_Low are the algebraic side currents consistent with P (Ratio is the HV:LV turns ratio, Lk_H the primary-referred leakage inductance). Ripple and winding resistance are excluded from this average model; efficiency evidence lands in the loss layer when calibrated.

inputPorts.description: Bridge phase shift, radians (lead-sign = HV leads LV); controller-side external (unwired zero-binds).
inputPorts.name: PhaseShift

outputPorts.description: Transferred power (signed: positive = HV -> LV), W.
outputPorts.name: P_Transfer

outputPorts.description: Current out of the HV side into the bridge, A.
outputPorts.name: I_High

outputPorts.description: Current out of the LV bus into the bridge, A (signed: NEGATIVE while the HV side delivers, i.e. the LV pack receives).
outputPorts.name: I_Low

outputPorts.description: Alias of P_Transfer: direct-wire draw for the HV-side DcBus.
outputPorts.name: P_DrawHigh

outputPorts.description: Alias of -P_Transfer: direct-wire draw for the LV-side DcBus.
outputPorts.name: P_DrawLow

Lk_H.description: Leakage inductance seen at the HV (primary) side, H.

description: Plant graph for the 2018 Zero DSR road pack (Zero ZF75-7 PMSM motor; dyno substituted by drive-cycle replay). 2026-10-21: machine constants FITTED from the test-11 ride (joint physics fit over launch/cruise delivered voltages + deep-FW dips + dc-power torque: Rs 8.7 mOhm, Ld 25.7 uH (high-saturation incremental class), Lq 65.7 uH, Lambda 0.0237; poles=5 verified in-data). Pack battery model from the sag anchors; TS3 channel of the three-strip NTC assembly wired; thermal strip constants being identified against the replay (twin/calib/fit_thermal_zf75.py). Encoder count bounds KEEP the bench identity - the bike's wider spread trips the replica EncoderLoss detector (per-card detector-bounds config is a follow-up; see twin/calib/cal_log.md item 10). The controller-side voltage-budget class for this build is Svpwm.MaxFrac 0.425 (fitted per-card; bike build diverges from the template 2/3 default). | Hardware-default caution: this rig models the bike's 900 A class bench (pack i_limit 900 / sink 600 A) with bike-firmware protection sets (oc_sw 1100 A, MaxTorqueCurrentA semantics per the graph); when porting to real hardware check protection/limit params per your board - a zero or stale value here is NOT safe by default.
